Smart Reads of the Week: Singapore Bank Earnings, Temasek Stocks, REIT Yields, and US Tech Opportunities
article:
Singapore REITs showed signs of recovery this week, with institutional investors returning to the sector even as many trusts remain in negative territory for the year.
Over in the US, Wall Street remained volatile as Nvidia’s leadership shake-up rattled technology stocks, while inflation concerns and rising oil prices kept investors cautious.
With markets sending mixed signals, where can investors find dependable income and opportunities for long-term growth?
This week’s Smart Reads examines the latest DBS, OCBC and UOB earnings, Temasek-linked companies rewarding shareholders with special dividends, and blue chips outperforming the broader market.
We also explore why Singapore REITs have lagged the STI, compare CPF Special Account interest with dividend compounding, and examine how to distinguish attractive yields from potential value traps.
Finally, we look at four Singapore stocks worth considering with S$30,000 and three US stocks that have fallen 30% from their peaks.
Here are this week’s top articles:
3 Temasek-Linked SGX Stocks Rewarding Investors with Special Dividends
These three Temasek-linked companies are rewarding shareholders with extra payouts. We explore what is driving them.
OCBC Beats Expectations While DBS and UOB Miss: What Happened in 3Q 2026?
Singapore’s three banks delivered mixed results. Discover what drove their performance and what investors should watch.
Singapore REITs Are Down 8% While the STI Is Up 25%: Should Income Investors Be Worried?
REITs have lagged Singapore’s broader market. We examine whether the weakness presents risks or potential opportunities.
Top 3 Temasek-Backed Blue Chips Beating the Market YTD
These three blue chips have outperformed the market this year. Find out what has supported their gains.
The Mathematics of Compounding: CPF SA Guaranteed Interest vs Variable Blue-Chip Dividend Growth
How does CPF’s guaranteed interest compare with growing dividends? We examine the long-term impact of compounding.
4 Singapore Stocks I Would Buy If I Had S$30,000 to Spare
With S$30,000 to invest, these four Singapore stocks offer different opportunities for building long-term wealth.
High Payouts vs Value Traps: How to Screen the Top 5 SGX Yielders
High dividend yields can be tempting. Learn how to identify sustainable payouts and avoid potential value traps.
3 US Stocks Down 30%: Are They Worth a Look?
Three US technology stocks have fallen sharply. We examine whether their valuations offer opportunities or signal further risks.
